provenance_zh: 全部为虚构结构与版本案例；系数不是已验证参数，无真实业务表、评价或调权重运行。
provenance_en: All rows are fictional schema/version cases; coefficients are unvalidated. No live business tables, evaluations or weight updates are claimed.

cards.name: weight_topics
cards.description_zh: 统一话题身份；DeFi、游戏不因名称写法不同重复建档。
cards.description_en: Stable topic identities shared by weight rules and evaluations.
rules_zh: 话题有独立 ID，不自动成为 #1001 的资产类别。
消息如何识别话题、多话题分配和话题合并待定义；不是账号的永久身份标签。
rules_en: Topics have their own IDs; they are not automatically assets.
Message classification, multi-topic allocation and merges remain undefined.

cards.name: weight_rules_current
cards.description_zh: 按用途与范围保存当前权重；账号规则直接引用 #1001 的账号 UUID，不使用所属项目替代。
cards.description_en: Current rules by purpose and scope; account weights directly reference the account asset UUID, not its project.
rules_zh: 同一用途/层级/范围只有一条当前规则；NULL 表示默认范围，不等于缺失匹配结果。
subject_asset_id 引用独立账号；所属项目用 #1003 表达，不自动继承或传分。
同层使用更具体规则覆盖默认；多条件冲突需拒绝发布，不重复相乘。跨层公式与系数仅演示。
发布前核对当前行全部范围及系数与版本快照一致，批次固定完整快照；更新不混新旧层。
rules_en: One current rule per purpose/layer/scope; NULL denotes a default scope.
subject_asset_id references the independent account; project ownership does not propagate scores.
A more specific rule overrides its default within a layer; ambiguous matches must block publication. Cross-layer math remains illustrative.
Validate scope/value equality against the referenced version before publication; each batch pins a complete snapshot.

cards.name: weight_rule_versions
cards.description_zh: 保留规则范围和系数的不可变版本；同一个账号不因调权重生成新身份。
cards.description_en: Immutable rule scope and coefficient versions; changing weights does not create a new account identity.
rules_zh: 手工规则允许没有评价引用；自动调整必须有可追溯评价依据，方法尚未确定。
示例 A 的 DeFi 从 1.5 到 1.8，仅演示版本；账号 UUID 与 rule_id 均保持不变。
追加版本，不覆盖旧版；重试保留原决定。历史回放按当时可知证据和版本，不能套用当前值。
rules_en: Manual rules may have no evaluations; automatic updates require traceable evaluated evidence and a defined method.
The fictional DeFi change from 1.5 to 1.8 keeps account and rule identity.
Append versions; retries keep their original decision. Historical replay must use evidence and versions available then.

cards.name: weight_evaluations
cards.description_zh: 保存一次判断的评价依据；结果未知时保留待评价，不推定正确或错误。
cards.description_en: Retain evidence for evaluating a judgment; unknown outcomes stay pending.
rules_zh: 原文引用、对象、话题、评价目标与窗口定义评价范围；去重不得把转述算独立成功。
未到观察时间或无结果不算错误；结果不明确使用 inconclusive。
自动评价、观察窗口、数值含义、更新频率和历史证据回填尚未实施。
rules_en: Deduplicate evaluation scope; reposts are not independent successes.
Do not mark pending judgments wrong; inconclusive is a separate outcome.
Automatic evaluation, scoring semantics, cadence and evidence backfill remain unimplemented.

weight_evaluations.create_sql: CREATE TABLE weight_evaluations (evaluation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, source_ref TEXT NOT NULL, subject_asset_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assets(asset_id), topic_id TEXT REFERENCES weight_topics(topic_id), evaluation_key TEXT NOT NULL, window_start TEXT NOT NULL, window_end TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(window_end>window_start), status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('pending','evaluated','inconclusive')), result REAL, evidence_ref TEXT, method_version TEXT, evaluated_at TEXT, CHECK ((status='pending' AND result IS NULL AND evaluated_at IS NULL) OR (status='evaluated' AND result IS NOT NULL AND evidence_ref IS NOT NULL AND method_version IS NOT NULL AND evaluated_at IS NOT NULL AND evaluated_at>=window_end) OR (status='inconclusive' AND result IS NULL AND evidence_ref IS NOT NULL AND evaluated_at IS NOT NULL AND evaluated_at>=window_end)))

examples.note_zh: 账号 A/B 与项目 P 是三个独立 UUID；所属关系不合并身份，不自动把消息计给 P。
examples.note_en: Accounts A/B and project P have three distinct UUIDs. Ownership neither merges identities nor assigns every message to P.

performance_zh: 当前权重按键批量加载到内存；每批固定完整版本快照，缺失键合并读取，不按消息逐条远程查询。
只为默认和例外建行，不预生成账号×话题×项目全组合；工作集过大分块关联，避免多对多匹配倍增。
评价依据与完整历史不进入打分热路径；增量更新及窗口过期维护需配合所选算法。
热度衰减使用已冻结贡献，不再次查作者当前权重。真实吞吐、缓存刷新和故障政策未验证。
performance_en: Batch-load keyed current weights into memory and pin a complete snapshot per batch; coalesce missing keys rather than querying per message.
Store defaults and exceptions, not every account/topic/project combination. Chunk large working sets; prevent join fan-out.
Keep evaluation evidence and full history off the scoring path; incremental/expiry maintenance depends on the eventual algorithm.
Decay frozen contributions without looking up current author weights. Throughput, cache refresh and failure policies remain unverified.
unknowns_zh: 评价目标与方法、自动更新算法/频率、话题识别与多话题处理尚未确定。
生产数据库、消费者、权重缓存与发布服务尚未接入；卡片引用不触发执行。
unknowns_en: Evaluation targets/methods, automatic update algorithms/cadence and topic classification/allocation remain undefined.
No production database, consumer, weight cache or publication service is connected; reference edges never execute.
